assets.prompt: Edit the provided pixel-art sheet for Đại Lực Kim Cương Chưởng, retaining its exact recognizable open golden five-finger palm design, golden player costume, three-quarter RPG perspective and impact style. Redesign the presentation as a LANDSCAPE TRANSPARENT two-row mode comparison board with huge clear gutters. Top row is only the NORMAL attack: on the left a small copy of the saffron monk performing the open-palm thrust, on the right EXACTLY ONE large upright open-palmed golden energy projectile in flight traveling horizontally right, centered on the middle track, one short thin amber streak extending backward from its wrist. Bottom row is only the EMPOWERED attack: on the left the same monk casting, on the right EXACTLY THREE detached upright open-palm golden projectiles of the SAME size and orientation, in a clear vertical stack with ample empty space between the upper, center, and lower hands. The three are at the same horizontal position and travel in THREE DISTINCT PARALLEL straight horizontal lanes to the right, with a separate thin gold trail pointing to the left behind each hand. No diagonal fan and no fourth projectile. In each row allow a small separate palm-impact cel at the far-right if there is generous space, but make it an abstract gold starburst with no hand silhouette so the number of hands remains unmistakable. Use rich warm gold and ivory with stepped pixel highlights and crisp anatomy, clear unpainted space between objects. Entire sheet has native transparent alpha, no fog wash or broad bloom, no text, no arrows, no dividers, no backdrop.

Edit the provided six-cel La Hán Quyền sheet. Preserve the approved designs of the stern elderly golden La Hán apparition, heavy prayer beads, layered bronze-gold robes and small bald saffron player monk. Keep 3 columns × 2 rows, transparent gutters, one identical player foot baseline per row, right-facing elevated orthographic game camera. Shift the whole apparition up on the screen relative to the player by roughly one quarter of the player's body height, and a little left, behind him. The apparition hovers visibly higher in the world. All three punches must drive DIAGONALLY FORWARD AND DOWN toward a point on the GROUND far to the player's right. This is not a horizontal punch or uppercut. Each extended arm and the qi path descends toward screen-right, from higher shoulder at left to lower knuckles at right. In each of the three attack cels show a separate LOW ground explosion exactly where the descending punch lands, well ahead of the player's feet, with a flat gold elliptical shockwave, small upward sparks and 2–4 broken stone flecks, no painted environment. Set impact ellipse at the same floor height as the player feet. Give the arm and trail a long reach by placing the player within the left half of each cell. Top left materializes. Top middle quick first downward punch with small ground hit. Top right second downward punch from the opposite shoulder with medium ground hit. Bottom left longer heavier downward punch and stronger ground explosion. Bottom middle apparition fades behind stationary player. Bottom right is isolated gold ground-impact FX on alpha, with no monk or apparition. Keep the distinct torso turns between the three punches and sharp hand-drawn pixel clusters. Enough transparent margins so the fists and ground bursts are never cropped. No words or grid. Preserve true alpha, keep broad bloom restrained.

Edit this exact 4-column × 3-row Thiếu Lâm Quyền sprite-art board. Keep the character, all eight body poses, the first three FX in the bottom row, the grid spacing, and native transparent background. Replace ONLY the bottom-right cell's projectile with a genuine yellow-gold SEMICIRCULAR CRESCENT of kick qi for the spinning back kick directly above it. Shape specification: a clean open half-moon curved blade, like the right half of a bright ring, arc of about 180 degrees from upper-left tip curving to the rightmost outer edge then back down to lower-left tip. The inside of the crescent is fully transparent and open to the left. It is visibly curved top-to-bottom with two separate tapered tips, with no central spear point, no filled arrowhead, no line or beam through its empty center. Add only a few thin amber sparks to the left of the crescent, with the bright edge flying right. The arc is short-range, tight, about the height of the monk's torso, separate for export. Use a clean ivory-gold edge and hard stepped 2D pixel art clusters without red or green fringe. Keep all other cells unchanged. No background or text.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW right-facing transparent pixel-art board for two modes of Vô Ảnh Cước in Võ Lâm Hero Defense. Input 1 locks the player identity, camera and pixel style: bald young chibi Shaolin monk, layered saffron wrap, brown cuffs, small cloth shoes, elevated orthographic three-quarter view. Input 2 is ONLY the airborne kick body-geometry reference, mirror its direction to screen-right. Do not copy the man, gi, belt, background or realism. Layout is 2 columns by 2 rows, wide transparent margins and no graphic dividers. TOP LEFT: normal grounded cast, one small monk on the left, showing the heel flick. TOP RIGHT: exactly THREE detached golden FOOT-SHAPED energy projectiles heading right in clearly separated upper, middle, lower straight horizontal lanes, vertically stacked and same size. Each is an unmistakable glowing human foot silhouette with projecting heel, arch and toe tips, oriented sole-forward in three-quarter view; each has its own short leftward trail. No hand or fist silhouettes. BOTTOM LEFT: clean isolated hero-only silhouette for the empowered flying kick with both feet clearly off the ground, extended rightward leg nearly horizontal and straight from the hip, rear leg sharply folded underneath and behind him with knee bent, torso leaning slightly away from the striking heel, front forearm reaching to balance and rear fist close to collarbone. Match the exact asymmetric side-kick geometry of photo mirrored right, with game perspective. BOTTOM RIGHT: same empowered air kick pose in actual DASH release, clearly depict the player himself flying right, robe hem streams left, a low streak with two fading saffron motion echoes along the travel path behind the player, yellow-white crescent of force hugging the outstretched heel and a tiny contact flare in front. Body remains fully readable and no extra foot projectiles in empowered cels. Keep trail and kick flash close to the player without filling the whole cell. Premium hand-finished chibi wuxia pixel art, gold and warm ivory against saffron and deep brown, hard stepped highlights and restrained glow. Use genuine transparent alpha, no black fill, checkers, lettering, real environment, backdrop or watermark.

Create a new transparent pixel-art sheet adapting the exact Shaolin monk and four martial arts strikes of this approved sheet to two north/south facings. Use same monk and saffron/dark brown palette, bald chibi head, ochre robes and cloth boots, same elevated orthographic top-down RPG camera. Exactly four columns by two rows with large transparent gutters and no text. Each cell is one full-body contact pose with no VFX. Top row the monk faces DOWN toward the bottom of the screen, shows face and chest from overhead three-quarter viewpoint, all strikes foreshortened DOWN toward viewer, with feet and arms shown clearly. Bottom row the monk faces UP toward the top of the screen, shows the back of his bald head and robe, all strikes UP away from viewer, no front face except at the twisting back-kick. Column 1 = left straight punch, near left fist extending along direction of travel and right chambered. Column 2 = right straight punch from opposite shoulder and left fist chambered, obvious mirror handedness within the same facing. Column 3 = one front kick driving heel forward while torso still faces the travel direction, one planted foot. Column 4 = one sharply twisted spinning back kick, shoulders turn away from direction of travel, back toward us for down-facing kick and partial front toward us for up-facing kick, with one heel extending into the direction of travel and pivot foot planted. Use faithful compact proportions and fixed size and centered ground anchor. Strict grid positions, keep entire body silhouette inside each cell. Transparent alpha, no lettering, floor, labels, beams, glow, border or scenery.
